sentences.text:
The petitioner, on the basis of an agreement entered into with the 3rd respondent herein,
constructed a semi-permanent structure, which has been used as a 'Kanjikkada'.

The petitioner has filed the captioned writ petition pointing out that he had a licence for running the aforesaid shop, as evidenced by Ext.P3 issued by the 1st respondent Municipality, and though he sought for renewing the licence, the Municipality has not renewed the same, relying on the alleged unauthorised construction, as stated in Exts.P7 and P8.
2.

I have heard Sri. Jacob Sebastian, the learned counsel for the petitioner; Sri. Binoy Vasudevan,
the learned Standing Counsel for the Municipality; and Sri. Mohanakannan, the learned counsel for the 3rd respondent.
3.
The learned counsel for the 3rd respondent submits that, as of now, he is not the owner of the property, insofar as he has sold the same.
4. Taking note of the submissions made across the Bar, this Court notices that the petitioner was running the shop on the basis of a licence issued, as evidenced by Ext.P3.
This Court further notices that the petitioner had sought renewal of the WP(C) NO. 8327 OF 2023 2026:KER:11164 licence, as evidenced by Ext.P7.
Sri. Jacob Sebastian would submit that for the subsequent years also the petitioner had sought renewal of the licence, however, the Municipality has not issued any positive orders in this regard.
5. In my opinion, merely on the allegation of unauthorised construction, a licence once issued cannot be refused renewal.

Insofar as the petitioner has already applied for renewal of the licence,
this writ petition would stand disposed of directing the 1st respondent to renew the same, if the application is otherwise in order.
Ext.P7, to the extent it refuses to consider the application of renewal, stands quashed.

6. The petitioner shall also furnish a fresh application for renewal of licence for the current year and,
upon furnishing the said application, the 1st respondent Municipality shall consider the same and pass orders in tune with the directions contained above.
7. As regards the allegation contained in Ext.P7 with respect to the unauthorised construction, it is for the petitioner to seek regularisation, in accordance with law.
If the Municipality proposes to issue any notice with respect to the unauthorised construction, the same shall be issued in the name of the petitioner herein.
So as to enable the petitioner to seek renewal of the licence as above, the proceedings under Ext.P8 shall remain stayed for a period of eight weeks.
